grammar.summary: 本课回顾计算机发展史并赞叹巴格瑞特的预言，运用了 could have done 对过去能力的推测，用定语从句修饰计算机的用途与特性，并通过时间状语从句交代技术发展的时间脉络。

points.title: could have done 对过去的推测 (Past Possibility)
points.explanation: could have + 过去分词表示「本可以/本来可能做到（但未必做到）」，用于对过去可能性进行推测或感叹。本课用 Who could have imagined... 表达「谁能想得到」的感叹，凸显预测未来之难。

examples.en: Who could have imagined, in the mid 1970s, for example, that by the end of the 20th century, computers would be as common in people's homes as TV sets?
examples.cn: 举个例子吧，在20世纪70年代中叶又有谁能想得到在20世纪末的时候，家庭用的计算机会像电视机一样普遍？

examples.en: Nor could he have foreseen how we could use the Internet to obtain information on every known subject, so we can read it on a screen in our homes and even print it as well if we want to.
examples.cn: 他也无法预测到我们可以利用国际交互网获取有关任何已知专题的信息，以便在家里的屏幕上阅读，如果愿意的话甚至可以将其打印出来。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用关系代词 which/that 或关系副词 when 引导定语从句。本课用 which 修饰 uses、machines，用 when 修饰 a time，层层补充计算机用途与预言细节，使长句信息密集而清晰。

examples.en: Considering how recent these developments are, it is even more remarkable that as long ago as the 1960s, an Englishman, Leon Bagrit, was able to predict some of the uses of computers which we know today.
examples.cn: 想一想这些发展的时间多么短，就更觉得英国人莱昂.巴格瑞特有着非凡的能力。他在60年代就能预言我们今天知道的计算机的一些用途。

examples.en: Bagrit foresaw a time when computers would be small enough to hold in the hand, when they would be capable of providing information about traffic jams and suggesting alternative routes, when they would be used in hospitals to help doctors to diagnose illnesses, when they would relieve office workers and accountants of dull, repetitive clerical work.
examples.cn: 巴格瑞特预示有一天计算机可以小到拿在手上，计算机可以使办公室人员和会计免除那些枯燥、重复的劳动。

points.title: 时间状语从句 (Time Clauses)
points.explanation: 由 when 引导的时间状语从句交代动作发生的时间背景。本课用 when they would be... 连续排比，描述巴格瑞特预言中计算机未来的各种用途场景，形成气势磅礴的排比结构。

examples.en: Bagrit foresaw a time when computers would be small enough to hold in the hand, when they would be capable of providing information about traffic jams and suggesting alternative routes, when they would be used in hospitals to help doctors to diagnose illnesses, when they would relieve office workers and accountants of dull, repetitive clerical work.
examples.cn: 巴格瑞特预示有一天计算机可以小到拿在手上，计算机可以使办公室人员和会计免除那些枯燥、重复的劳动。

exercises.q: Who ______ have imagined, in the mid 1970s, for example, that by the end of the 20th century, computers would be as common in people's homes as TV sets?

Considering how recent these developments are, it is even more remarkable that as long ago as the 1960s, an Englishman, Leon Bagrit, was able to predict some of the uses of computers ______ we know today.
Bagrit foresaw a time ______ computers would be small enough to hold in the hand...
用 could have done 填空：Nor ______ he have foreseen how we could use the Internet to obtain information on every known subject.（填入与否定词 Nor 连用、引起倒装的情态助动词）
